name: Byakko no Kamikakushi
source:
That summer, I had the strangest experience at the village festival.

Separated from my friend I heard a voice call out to me. It was a seductive spirit in the form of a fox woman.

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE114431.html]DLSite English[/url]]
